First we investigate spin and orbital relaxation in monolayer MoS2, a prototypical system with strong SOC and valley-dependent orbital texture.
Spin and orbital relaxation at 300 K.

The system is initialized with a circularly-polarized pump with an excitation energy just above the band gap at 1.7 eV, and the resulting dynamics of the out-of-plane (alongz) spin and OAM are shown in Fig. 1.
CLM-MAT-0005.statement: In optically excited monolayer MoS2, spin and orbital polarization decay at long times with a lifetime of 6.1 ps at 300 K.
